description: This file contains functions for managing deferred revenue and expense accounting, including validation, booking, conversion, and error handling within an ERP system.

methods.name: validate_service_stop_date
methods.description: Validates that service stop dates are within start and end dates for invoice items.

methods.name: build_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on process type, account, and company for deferred revenue/expense queries.

methods.name: convert_deferred_expense_to_expense
methods.description: Books deferred expenses into actual expenses for a given process within a date range.

methods.name: convert_deferred_revenue_to_income
methods.description: Books deferred revenue into income for a given process within a date range.

methods.name: get_booking_dates
methods.description: Determines start and end dates for booking deferred revenue/expense based on previous GL or journal entries.

methods.name: calculate_monthly_amount
methods.description: Calculates the amount to book monthly for deferred revenue/expense based on service duration.

methods.name: calculate_amount
methods.description: Calculates the amount to book for deferred revenue/expense based on total days and booking days.

methods.name: get_already_booked_amount
methods.description: Retrieves the total amount already booked for a specific invoice item from GL entries and journal entries.

methods.name: book_deferred_income_or_expense
methods.description: Books deferred income or expense for invoice items, either via journal entry or GL entries.

methods.name: process_deferred_accounting
methods.description: Background process to convert deferred income/expenses into actual income/expenses at month end.

methods.name: make_gl_entries
methods.description: Creates GL entries for deferred income/expense adjustments.

methods.name: send_mail
methods.description: Sends email notification if deferred accounting processing encounters errors.

methods.name: book_revenue_via_journal_entry
methods.description: Creates and optionally submits a journal entry to book deferred revenue or expense.

methods.name: get_deferred_booking_accounts
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate debit or credit account for deferred revenue or expense items.
